description: Synthetic Forkyard seeds. expected_counts.records is the three repository objects in the package seed fixtures/minimal.json, which is what the package reports as objects. The evaluation partitions are the sources below. Counts are reproduced by node examples/coverage-report.cjs. See contribution/coverage.md.

sources.description: Registry smoke seed fixtures/minimal.json. Three repositories, 15 in-window dates (14 primary), 0 records before 2025, 2026-09-02 to 2026-11-17. The evaluation dataset is the owner-library source.

Fixture (a), examples/task-data/rejected-pr/seed.json. Activity from February 2024 through February 2026. 36 in-window dates, all primary. 47 records before 2025 are excluded. In-window range 2025-01-15 to 2026-02-06.
Fixture (b), examples/task-data/locked-project/seed.json. 4 in-window dates (3 primary), 0 records before 2025, 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-16.

Full-window evaluation dataset, examples/task-data/owner-library/seed.json, sha256 6e5c2283335fcd2dc0a9ccc78d3fad1cd2e9f3b4637a207c9d4e00210083c6a8. Repositories tomasreyes/notebook and tomasreyes/fieldbook. 291 in-window dates (290 primary), 28 records before 2025 excluded, 2025-01-02 to 2026-11-16, 23 of 24 months. 293 commits, 33 pull requests (30 merged), 37 reviews, 9 published releases and 1 draft, 13 tags, 40 checks. With the December events this seed reaches 295 dates. All five seeds plus December reach 325.
examples/task-data/release-attribution/seed.json. 6 in-window dates (5 primary), 0 records before 2025, 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-23.

Four staged events in examples/events/owner-library-2026-12/events.json. Two fieldbook pushes, one notebook review, one fieldbook tag, on 2026-12-03, 2026-12-08, 2026-12-10 and 2026-12-18. Applied after env.advance_time. Not seed history. All four commit.

transformations: Timestamps normalized to America/Los_Angeles before dates are counted. Records before 2025-01-01 stay in the seeds and are excluded from the window.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
